contract.title: TWIN-47 MC固件(AT32F435)控制命令全集打通、Marlin队列桥接、0x1C级联转发与真机交叉编译
contract.accepted_scope: C unit-test verification in Docker QA sandbox (gcc) of MC (AT32F435) MiniMCProto V2 control opcodes (0x10 SET_TEMP, 0x11 MOTION_HOME, 0x12 MOTION_MOVE, 0x13 JOB_CONTROL, 0x17 MOTION_STOP, 0x18 LEVEL_GRID_QUERY 0B/1B, 0x19 SLOT_SELECT local & TH cascade sync, 0x1A LEVEL_TRIGGER, 0x1C GCODE_EXEC & minimc_proto_send_th_gcode), Marlin queue/heater/quickStop bridging (with bare-board non-blocking strategy A), memu_gui.c 0x55 0xAA DWIN isolation, and genuine [MC-DBG] (USART1 115200) RX->STATE->TX ACK log emission without bypass calls. Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are not applicable in qa-sandbox:20261029 (host arm-none-eabi-gcc build is verified in author_01 and physical HIL in TWIN-50): qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-26 wk_usart.c与MC串口级联基线
继承TWIN-44 MC USART2 921600与USART1非阻塞[MC-DBG]环形缓冲日志基线

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；C模块单测与交叉编译自检；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

commands.expected: 容器/宿主gcc编译minimc_proto.c与test_twin44_mc_debug.c 0错误，全部正例（0x01/0x03/0x10/0x11/0x12/0x13/0x14/0x16/0x17/0x18(0B&1B)/0x19/0x1A/0x1C二进制控制与查询帧驱动Marlin桥接并自动触发[MC-DBG] RX->STATE->TX ACK、TH级联控制响应0x10->0x15/0x19->0x19/0x1C->0x1C关联同步、minimc_proto_send_th_gcode二进制封装）与反例及恢复（未知命令0xFE返回NACK 0x04、非法长度NACK 0x02、CRC错误与恢复、环形缓冲满丢包与恢复、非预期TH帧拦截与恢复、底层发送失败抑制伪ACK与恢复）单测PASS

positive_cases: minimc_proto.h与minimc_proto.c完整实现0x10(SET_TEMP)、0x11(MOTION_HOME)、0x12(MOTION_MOVE)、0x13(JOB_CONTROL)、0x17(MOTION_STOP)、0x18(LEVEL_GRID_QUERY 0B/1B)、0x19(SLOT_SELECT)、0x1A(LEVEL_TRIGGER)、0x1C(GCODE_EXEC)控制分支，真实调用Marlin桥接并触发mc_debug_notify_*输出[MC-DBG]
wk_usart.c的forward_uart_send_line升级为调用minimc_proto_send_th_gcode发送0x1C二进制级联帧，memu_gui.c隔离0x55 0xAA避免污染迪文屏状态机
negative_cases: 收到未知命令(如0xFE)、载荷长度不足或CRC错误帧时返回对应NACK/ERR日志且不破坏状态，后续合法帧立即恢复
环形缓冲满或底层发送失败时不阻塞业务且不伪造ACK，排空或恢复后正常闭环
